items.title: At TechBBQ, Europe's AI conversations kept coming back to: Who's actually in control?
items.summary: Investors, founders, and operators from across Europe arrived for the annual Nordic TechBBQ conference to talk about how humans can have agency over AI.
items.titleZh: 在TechBBQ上，欧洲的人工智能对话不断回到：谁真正在控制？
items.summaryZh: 来自欧洲各地的投资者、创始人和运营商参加了一年一度的北欧TechBBQ会议，讨论人类如何对人工智能拥有代理权。

items.title: The U.S. doesn’t have a state-owned oil giant. But in Venezuela, the federal government will control a company with the world’s 2nd largest reserves
items.summary: The federal government will control 55% of the company's effective output via equity ownership and oil production.
items.titleZh: 美国没有国有石油巨头。但在委内瑞拉，联邦政府将控制一家拥有世界第二大储量的公司
items.summaryZh: 联邦政府将通过股权和石油生产控制该公司55%的有效产出。

items.title: Bernie Sanders Vows Legislation to 'Stop Flock and AI Mass Surveillance'
items.summary: The Vermont senator warned that the surveillance company's 120,000-plus AI cameras are pushing the US toward a "surveillance state," adding a prominent voice to a growing bipartisan backlash.
items.titleZh: 伯尼·桑德斯誓言立法“阻止羊群和人工智能大规模监控”
items.summaryZh: 这位佛蒙特州参议员警告说，这家监控公司的12万多台人工智能摄像头正在将美国推向“监控州”，这为两党日益强烈的反对情绪增添了一个突出的声音。

items.title: Texas Gov. Greg Abbott says China isn't behind the anti-data-center debate
items.summary: Texas Gov. Greg Abbott said his data center pivot was driven by legitimate concerns from Texans, not by Chinese propaganda.
items.titleZh: 得克萨斯州州长格雷格·阿博特表示，中国并不支持反数据中心的辩论
items.summaryZh: 得克萨斯州州长格雷格·阿博特表示，他的数据中心转型是由得克萨斯人的合理担忧推动的，而不是中国的宣传。

items.title: OpenAI says it's ending its deal with Cursor because Elon Musk's companies violate contracts
items.summary: OpenAI said it doesn't trust SpaceX to comply with its terms of service, citing past conduct by xAI, another of Elon Musk's companies.
items.titleZh: OpenAI表示将终止与Cursor的交易，因为埃隆·马斯克的公司违反了合同
items.summaryZh: OpenAI表示，它不相信SpaceX会遵守其服务条款，理由是埃隆·马斯克的另一家公司xAI过去的行为。

items.title: Tech billionaires and executives like Evan Spiegel and Peter Thiel are publicly shielding their children from the products that made them rich
items.summary: As governments race to restrict minors’ social media use, the tech billionaires and execs who built the platforms are imposing screen limits at home.
items.titleZh: 埃文·斯皮格尔（Evan Spiegel）和彼得·蒂尔（Peter Thiel）等科技亿万富翁和高管公开保护他们的孩子免受让他们致富的产品的伤害
items.summaryZh: 随着政府竞相限制未成年人使用社交媒体，创建这些平台的科技亿万富翁和高管们正在家里实施屏幕限制。

items.title: This creator got 'micro-canceled' for promoting Claude. She says AI use is becoming a social taboo.
items.summary: The internet is getting their digital pitchforks out for influencers who promote AI. We spoke to a creator who was "micro-canceled."
items.titleZh: 这位创作者因推广克劳德而被“微取消”。她说，使用人工智能正在成为一种社会禁忌。
items.summaryZh: 互联网正在为推广人工智能的有影响力的人提供数字广告。我们采访了一位被“微取消”的创作者
